items: Build Your Entity Foundation: Open a new spreadsheet labeled "Entity Inventory Master" with columns for Entity Name, Entity Type, State of Formation, State(s) of Registration, Formation Date, EIN, Tax Classification, Registered Agent, Principal Address, and Notes.
Build Your Entity Foundation: Fill in every entity you own as a separate row in your spreadsheet, including entities you have not officially dissolved yet, so nothing falls through the cracks.
Build Your Entity Foundation: Export your entity inventory to cloud storage and set a recurring quarterly reminder to review and update it as your single source of truth going forward.

Build Your Entity Foundation: Add notes to each entity row for special circumstances, pending filings, or anything else that requires ongoing attention so the document captures your complete situation at a glance.
Configure Automated Reminders: Map all tax obligations by jurisdiction, listing every filing type, due date, and payment requirement for federal, state, and county levels across all your entities.

Configure Automated Reminders: Set automated reminders in your calendar system to send notifications 30 days before each tax deadline so you have adequate time to gather documents and prepare filings.

Configure Automated Reminders: Schedule internal buffer zones by targeting all filings and payments at least 5 business days before the actual deadline to prevent last-minute scrambles and processing delays.
Configure Automated Reminders: Create calendar blocks for year-end filing coordination that mark when each entity's return is due and when your accountant needs supporting documents from you.

Establish Maintenance Rhythms: Build audit-ready documentation by maintaining organized folders with copies of all filed returns, correspondence with tax authorities, and payment receipts organized by year and entity.

Establish Maintenance Rhythms: Create backup protocols by designating a second person in your organization or an external accountant who can access your tax calendar and deadlines if you are unavailable.

Establish Maintenance Rhythms: Schedule quarterly system reviews where you verify that all entities are properly registered, check for any law changes affecting your obligations, and update your reminder system accordingly.

Establish Maintenance Rhythms: Design your system to survive your busiest seasons and planned time off by ensuring all deadlines are visible, reminders are automated, and backup contacts know your filing schedule.
